title.narrative: Strengthening Capacity of Civil Society in Budget Monitoring

description.narrative: The Action will address the key causes of corruption. This will include the issue of low fiscal transparency in the country and the fact that public access is almost non-existent as well as the anecdotal and therefore ineffective nature of civil society participation in monitoring fiscal transparency, given its lack of capacity to monitor financial transactions and the lack of access to information. It appears that little effort is made to institute rules and practices to ensure that public funds are used in the most efficient and effective way and that the system delivers the best value for money.
